summary.tagline: Ascent of the highest peak in Northern Ireland through ancient woodland and rugged granite peaks.
summary.seo_title: Hiking Slieve Donard: The Highest Mourne Mountain

travel.headline: Open Access in the Mournes
travel.reservation: Access to the mountain from Donard Park is generally open without advance booking, though the local council manages the trailhead parking. Visitors should check for any localized events or temporary notices from Newry, Mourne and Down District Council before arrival.

days.title: Summiting the Mourne Giant

stops.name: Slieve Donard
stops.detail: Ascend the Glen River path through Scots Pine and Oak woodland toward the 850m summit for views of the Isle of Man and Scotland.

days.driving: Minimal; the trailhead is located within the town limits of Newcastle.
days.note: Stay close to the Mourne Wall during the descent to the Saddle and avoid the steep Eagle Rocks cliffs.

intel.title: Glen River Bridges
intel.text: The route involves crossing three bridges over the Glen River during the woodland section. Hikers must transition between banks to follow the established mountain track.

intel.title: Summit Visibility
intel.text: Clear conditions are required to see distant landmarks like Wales or the Wicklow Mountains. Check regional mountain weather forecasts as visibility can change rapidly at 850m.

intel.title: Donard Park
intel.text: The primary trailhead is located at Donard Park car park in Newcastle. Evidence does not specify current capacity or fees; verify locally before arrival.

intel.title: Connectivity Status
intel.text: Signal strength in the Glen River valley and the Mourne summit is not documented in official sources. Always carry a physical map and do not rely on digital navigation.

intel.title: Regional Supplies
intel.text: The town of Newcastle serves as the primary hub for supplies. Evidence does not list specific refueling stations; check regional maps for the nearest fuel before entering the mountains.

plan.arrival: Arrive in Newcastle and proceed to Donard Park to locate the trailhead. This town-side entrance provides immediate access to the Glen River woodland path.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for reaching the trailhead in Newcastle; no specialized mountain vehicle is required for the town-based parking.
plan.goldenHour: Newcastle Beach viewpoint for sunset views over the Irish Sea, with the silhouette of the Mournes behind you.
